svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: In unicast mode the uplink egress hook on host 1 wraps the neighbor solicitation in IPv4 protocol 41 and sends one copy to each peer. The ingress hook on each peer accepts it only from a peer address and unwraps it.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: accept from a peer only, unwrap
